newsitem.title: USA: Network sees no big ramp up before Q4.
newsitem.headline: Network sees no big ramp up before Q4.

text.p: Network Computing Devices Inc said Tuesday that the current sales trend implies orders will not grow significantly in the third quarter.
"Indeed, we do not expect any significant ramping up sooner than the fourth quarter of this year," the company said.

"Based on what we see through our partnership with IBM -- as well as in our own direct and reseller sales channels -- customers are not placing large orders until they have thoroughly evaluated trial systems," the company added.
On Tuesday the company reported a second quarter profit of $0.04 a share, compared to a loss of $0.37 in the year-ago quarter.
